header.title: Our Craft
header.description: Different materials, different hands, different techniques — someone who knows exactly what they're doing behind every one. Here's a closer look at our craft, category by category.

sections.title: Clay Works & Jewellery
sections.description: Shaped and molded by hand, piece by piece, using clay that's kind to the earth. That's really the whole process.
sections.fact: Made with eco-friendly clay — molded entirely by hand, with no machines and no shortcuts.

sections.title: Hand-Painted Textiles
sections.description: Every pattern is painted on by hand, one fine brushstroke at a time
sections.fact: The patterns are passed down by memory, not written instructions — no two artisans paint them quite the same way.

sections.title: Everyday Totes
sections.fact: The canvas is left unbleached on purpose — it's tougher, and it ages better with use

sections.title: DIY Kits
sections.description: A kit with everything you need to make your own piece at home

sections.title: Made for you
sections.description: Start with an idea, however rough. We'll shape a kit around it — the right patterns, the right tools, the right materials, just for you.

sections.title: Customized Kits
sections.description: Wedding, anniversary, a gift that matters — tell us the occasion, we'll pack everything into one kit.
